# gitmoap_group_catalog_services (Data Source)

List a group's services, each with its deployment promotion track. Returns the services declared in this group, alphabetically by slug, each with one deployment entry per environment tier. Filter by `kind`, `lifecycle`, `source` (inferred, declared or api) or `search`; a service whose declaration has disappeared is left out unless `include_orphaned=true`. Pages hold up to 100 services (20 by default; a larger `limit` is reduced rather than refused) and continue with `next_token`.

The token needs `catalog:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_catalog_services" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The declaring group's id

### Optional

- `include_orphaned` (Boolean) Include entries whose declaration has disappeared (excluded by default)
- `kind` (String) Filter by service kind
- `search` (String) Match the name, description or a slug substring
- `source` (String) Filter by how the entry came to exist

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `deployments` (Attributes List) At most one entry per tier, ordered `development`, `testing`, `staging`, `production`. Empty
for a `library`, an external service, or anything never deployed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--deployments))
- `service` (Attributes) The short form of a service that listings, search results and path lookups show. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--service))

<a id="nestedatt--items--deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.deployments`

Read-Only:

- `deployed` (Boolean)
- `status` (String) Where a deployment is in its life. It starts `requested`; waits as `awaiting_approval` when the
environment needs approval, ending `rejected` if refused; then `running`, ending `succeeded`,
`failed` or `cancelled`. `skipped` means another deploy held the environment and its policy is to
skip. A successful deployment becomes `superseded` when a later one replaces it.
- `tier` (String) What kind of environment this is, whatever it is called: `development`, `testing`, `staging`
or `production`. A `production` environment is protected by default.


<a id="nestedatt--items--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.service`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String)
- `external` (Boolean)
- `group_id` (String)
- `kind` (String) What sort of thing a service is. The kind decides which scorecard checks apply: a `library` has
no deployments, so a deployment check is not applicable to it rather than failing. For your own
classifications, use annotations.
- `lifecycle` (String) Where a service is in its life.
- `orphaned_at` (String)
- `service_id` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `source` (String) How the catalog entry came to exist. Set by the platform, never accepted from a request. Any
source other than `inferred` means a person has vouched for the entry.
